description: Partner accounts only. Get a single-use link to upload one audio file (MP3, WAV, FLAC) or, for films, one video (MP4, MOV), up to 2 GB, valid for 10 minutes. Send the file to it with HTTP PUT; the response is the stored track. Give the track its name, position and credits here. Request one link per file.

articleId.description: Release id from list_releases or create_release.

filename.description: The file's name; its extension decides the type.

name.description: Track title; defaults to the filename.

preview.description: Films only: this file is the trailer.

name: create_track_upload

command.description: A curl command that uploads the file; replace <file> with its path.

error.description: Present when the call did not succeed.

reason.description: not_a_partner when the signed-in account has no partner account.

title: Get a track upload link
